facts.title: Oasis 2025 Reunion Tour Beer Record at Wembley – 250,000 Pints in Three Nights
facts.body: The Oasis reunion tour in 2025 set a record at Wembley Stadium for the greatest quantity of beer consumed: 250,000 pints over three nights, approximately 2.5 pints per person. "Set a record at Wembley Stadium for the most beer consumed: 250,000 pints in three nights."
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

"Very few rap songs period, let alone rap diss songs, had ever won a major Grammy," highlighting a significant shift in mainstream recognition for the genre. facts.title: Lawsuit by Summers and Copeland (2025)
facts.body: In 2025, Sting's bandmates, guitarist Andy Summers and drummer Stuart Copeland, initiated a lawsuit against Sting, seeking arranger's fees they claim are owed for "Every Breath You Take." They argue that their instrumental contributions were vital to the song's distinctive sound and enduring popularity, drawing a parallel to DJ Stonebridge's lack of recognition for "Show Me Love." "Stings to police bandmates, guitarist Andy Summers and drummer Stuart Copeland have sued Sting for what they say they are owed for a ranger's fees on every breath you take."
facts.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
facts.episode: If You Love Sting, Set Him Free Edition Part 1

facts.title: Mani Death (2025) – Distinctive Bass Lines Sung by Audiences Before Vocals Entered
facts.body: Mani (Gary Mounfield), bassist of Stone Roses and Primal Scream, died in 2025. His bass lines on songs such as "I Wanna Be Adored" were so distinctive and immediately recognizable that audiences would sing them aloud before the vocals even entered. He was a key contributor to the "Madchester" sound. "His bass line in songs like 'I Wanna Be Adored' was so distinctive that the audience sang it before the voice entered."
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
facts.name: The Stone Roses

facts.title: Brian Wilson Death (2025) – Respiratory Failure and Sepsis After Long COVID
facts.body: Brian Wilson, creative genius of The Beach Boys, died in 2025. He had battled mental health issues since the 1960s and subsequent cognitive decline. His death was complicated by long COVID contracted in 2022, which led to respiratory failure and sepsis. "His death was complicated by long COVID contracted in 2022, leading to respiratory failure and sepsis."
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
facts.name: The Beach Boys

facts.title: Clem Burke Death (2025) – Cancer Kept Secret
facts.body: Clem Burke, original drummer of Blondie, died in 2025 of cancer, which had been kept secret. He briefly played with the Ramones under the name Elvis Ramone. He also participated in an eight-year academic study on the physical and psychological effects of being a professional drummer, for which he received an honorary doctorate in music. "His cancer was kept secret."
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
facts.name: Blondie

facts.title: Roy Thomas Baker Death (2025) – Producer of Bohemian Rhapsody
facts.body: Roy Thomas Baker, the English producer who guided Queen through their greatest years — including the recording of "Bohemian Rhapsody" — died in 2025 at age 78. He also shaped the distinctive sound of The Cars and worked with artists ranging from David Bowie to Metallica and Guns N' Roses. "Remembered for guiding Queen in their greatest years, including 'Bohemian Rhapsody.'"
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

facts.title: Super Bowl Halftime Performer (2025)
facts.body: One week after winning five Grammys, Kendrick Lamar was the half-time performer at the 2025 Super Bowl. This invitation from the NFL "was fueled by Not Like Us," showcasing the song's massive cultural impact and mainstream appeal despite its controversial nature. "Kendrick Lamar was the half-time performer at the 2025 Super Bowl, an invitation from the NFL that was fueled by Not Like Us."

facts.title: Performing "Biggest Diss Record of All Time" at Super Bowl (2025)
facts.body: Despite an ongoing defamation lawsuit from Drake, Kendrick Lamar chose to perform "Not Like Us" at the 2025 Super Bowl Halftime Show, recognizing it as "the biggest diss record of all time" and an unprecedented opportunity to perform it "to the biggest television audience in history." "Lamar wasn't going to pass up the opportunity to perform the biggest disrecord of all time to the biggest television audience in history."

facts.title: David Johansen Death (2025) – Stage 4 Brain Cancer at 75
facts.body: David Johansen, charismatic frontman of proto-punk pioneers New York Dolls, died at age 75. He had been diagnosed with stage 4 brain cancer and was also facing costly surgeries for a back fracture. After the Dolls dissolved, he adopted the persona of Buster Poindexter. "Diagnosed with stage 4 brain cancer and facing costly surgeries for a back fracture."
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

facts.title: Death (2025) – Heart Attack at 76, Final Concert a Medical Miracle
facts.body: Ozzy Osbourne died at age 76 of a heart attack. His final concert, held in Birmingham two weeks before his death, was considered a near-miracle given his severe Parkinson's disease, chronic pain, and a secret prior hospitalization. He dictated his final autobiography, *Last Rights*, the day before he died. "His last concert in Birmingham, two weeks before his death, was considered a miracle due to his severe Parkinson's, chronic pain, and a secret prior hospitalization."
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

facts.title: "Not Like Us" Wins Five Grammys (2025)

This was "unprecedented" for a rap song and a diss track, marking a historic moment for the awards and the genre. "On February 2nd, 2025, on the 67th annual Grammy Awards Not Like Us won five Grammys, including both record and song of the year."

facts.title: Kendrick Lamar's Performance Fueled by "Not Like Us" (2025)

facts.title: Contemporary Fascination with the Medieval (2025)
facts.body: In 2025, there is a widespread craze for all things medieval, reflecting an aesthetic that has been cultivated for years in cinema, video games, and music. "Definitivamente, en 2025 nos hemos vuelto locos por lo medieval. Este año acabo doculó siendo una estética que llevaba años cultivándose en el cine, en los videojuegos o la música."
